# PipeWire headers

Public headers of PipeWire 1.4.2 (`pipewire-0.3` and `spa-0.2`), as shipped by Debian 13's
`libpipewire-0.3-dev` 1.4.2-1, for building DroidNux's PipeWire module (`guest/pipewire`) with the NDK.
MIT license, see `COPYING`. Headers only: the module links against the guest's libpipewire at load time.
